## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -8.89% | 1M: -18.41%) ↓ falling and HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +0.55%) ↑ rising show risk metrics easing, while TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +1.34%) ↑ rising signals bond demand—mixed signals support NEUTRAL.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit holding firm: LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +0.79%) ↑ rising and HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +0.55%) ↑ rising. Fear easing via VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -8.89% | 1M: -18.41%) ↓ falling, offset by concurrent bond bid in TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +1.34%) ↑ rising.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral: UUP in CORRECTION (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +1.60%) → flat and SPY in RECOVERY (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -0.08%) → flat, while TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +1.34%) ↑ rising keeps financial conditions mixed.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Tech leadership intact: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.50% | 1M: +4.50%) ↑ rising and QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +3.36%) ↑ rising; Financials also strong: XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.29% | 1M: +5.82%) ↑ rising. Energy is the lone laggard: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -0.21% | 1M: -0.14%) → flat.

5. US vs Global?  
US large caps mixed: SPY RECOVERY (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -0.08%) → flat while small caps IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.95% | 1M: +3.83%) ↑ rising. EM strength notable: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.09% | 1M: +1.00%) ↑ rising; China FXI in RECOVERY (1W: +1.55% | 1M: -7.76%) ↑ rising but still lagging on 1M.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation mixed but present: ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.94% | 1M: +2.09%) ↑ rising and IBIT in RECOVERY (1W: +5.57% | 1M: -20.12%) ↑ rising; IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.95% | 1M: +3.83%) ↑ rising supports risk-on tilt in smaller caps.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Industrial metals showing tentative strength: CPER in RECOVERY (1W: +3.86% | 1M: -1.79%) ↑ rising while Gold GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -2.45% | 1M: -10.21%) ↓ falling and Silver SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -0.45% | 1M: -22.76%) ↓ falling reflect commodity weakness elsewhere.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy weak: BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -6.60% | 1M: -14.38%) ↓ falling and XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -0.21% | 1M: -0.14%) → flat; NatGas UNG in CORRECTION (1W: -2.74% | 1M: +3.37%) ↓ falling shows short-term pullback.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Tech (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.50% | 1M: +4.50%)) and Semis (SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +12.86%)) both timeframes positive. DIVERGENCES: commodity ETFs and some industry names show 1W vs 1M mismatches (SKYY CORRECTION (1W: -4.79% | 1M: +6.69%), IBIT RECOVERY (1W: +5.57% | 1M: -20.12%)) — treat as minor dislocations.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor exposure to XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.50% | 1M: +4.50%) and XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.29% | 1M: +5.82%) showing relative strength, and monitor SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +12.86%) for momentum; reduce exposure to GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -2.45% | 1M: -10.21%) and BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -6.60% | 1M: -14.38%).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Technology (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.50% | 1M: +4.50%)) and Semiconductors (SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +12.86%)).  
BEARISH: Energy (XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -0.21% | 1M: -0.14%)) and Oil (BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -6.60% | 1M: -14.38%)).

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Copper (CPER RECOVERY (1W: +3.86% | 1M: -1.79%)) as industrial signal.  
BEARISH: Gold (GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -2.45% | 1M: -10.21%)) and Silver (SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -0.45% | 1M: -22.76%)).

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~20 (complacency level) — VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -8.89% | 1M: -18.41%). HYG/LQD spread ~0.80 (credit health) — HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +0.55%), LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +0.79%). XLK/XLF relative pivot ~2.0 for growth vs value rotation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive supporting broad participation but risk metrics and bond demand are mixed. Tech and semiconductors showing strength (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.50% | 1M: +4.50%), SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +12.86%)); watch commodity divergences and bond bid (GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -2.45% | 1M: -10.21%), TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +1.34%)).
